title: Cymba anatomically informed schematic with exaggerated violet activity — reference v7
direction: Solid ivory marble with blank stone eyes. Localized upper conchal target, dashed projected deep anterolateral cervical routes, stronger abstract violet cranial illumination. No scalp nerve trees, exposed brain, glass, cheek arc or rear neck pathway.
caption: Illustrative brain activity. Dashed lines indicate projected deep pathways.
notes: The brain light field is a symbolic artistic effect, not measured activation, an anatomical map or evidence of device efficacy.
Dashed cervical routes are approximate surface projections of deep nerves. Precise depth, fine auricular innervation and individual variation are not encoded by these generated images.
Rear ear highlights were removed because the anterior conchal targets are occluded from the rear view.
This is an anatomically informed concept reference, not a clinically validated anatomical illustration.
Generated geometry and exact routes may vary between views; reconcile in 3D modelling. No live site or 3D model changed.

This is an anatomically informed SCHEMATIC PROJECTION onto solid stone, not literal superficial nerves.

FIRST REMOVE EVERY EXISTING PURPLE LINE. The entire crown, scalp, forehead, temple, cheek, posterior head and nape must become PLAIN UNMARKED MARBLE. Absolutely no cranial trees, scalp nerves, glowing brain outline, brain glow or branches over the neck. Head remains fully closed, solid, opaque marble. No glass or interior effect.

ADD ONLY THESE RESTRAININED MARKS:
1. A small delicate violet highlight in the visible ear's CYMBA CONCHAE: the UPPER conchal pocket directly ABOVE the transverse crus of the helix, not the dark ear-canal entrance, not the lower concha bowl, not the lobe, not the entire ear. A tiny localized patch of a few short branching fibres gives the nerve-fibre texture the user wants. Keep this anatomically small. Low controlled violet/lilac glow.
2. A SHORT, FAINT DASHED violet line projects the auricular branch's deep route medially from this ear target toward the skull-base/jugular region. It must disappear as it goes inward behind the ear. Do not draw a nerve up the temple or across the cheek. Do not join the ear patch to the neck with an exposed continuous cable. No glowing brainstem dot on the scalp.
3. ONE very thin, faint, sparsely DASHED violet projection on the visible ANTEROLATERAL neck, indicating the deep cervical vagus within the carotid sheath. It starts below the skull base, deep to the angle of the jaw, and descends alongside the throat, beneath the sternocleidomastoid region, toward the base of the neck. It is on the FRONT-SIDE part of the neck, not along the back contour or nape. Only one cervical trunk per side in the imagined anatomy; in this three-quarter view show only the near-side projection clearly, allow the far side to be naturally occluded. This line is dimmer than the small ear highlight, very fine, dashed, and UNBRANCHED. It must NOT split into a web. No nerves over the posterior neck, no spinal midline line.

IMPORTANT: At least 95 percent of the statue is clean plain marble. Highlight detail is localized at the tiny upper ear target; deep routes use deliberately diagrammatic thin dashes to avoid falsely presenting them as surface anatomy. No invented wide fibre bundles, scalp trees, extra cranial nerves, decorative twigs, arrows or activity across the brain. Preserve natural occlusion. Purple/amethyst dominant with no pink.
No text, labels or legend on this clean modelling image. No earbuds, wires, jewelry, clothing or extra objects. Quiet premium professional sculpture.
